summary: Frontend-only testing of Drive integration (association resources, project & task drive links separate from external links) and Loyalty pagination/filters. All specified UI wiring is in place and works correctly. Drive resources CRUD by Bureau in /admin/settings works (create, chip with 'Ouvrir dans Drive' link, delete via kebab menu). On ProjectDetail, 'Liens Google Drive' block is clearly separated from 'Liens externes' — adding a drive link only appears in the drive block; external count remained unchanged (0/0). Each task has both task-drive-<id> and task-links-<id> (6 of each on tested project). Loyalty tab filter bar (loyalty-members-filters) exposes statut/niveau/récent controls plus total count; setting Niveau min=999 reduces total from 1 to 0 (filter applied server-side). Pagination bar not rendered (seed has 1 active member — expected). Test cleanups performed (drive resource and stale drive link removed).
critical_code_review_comments: DriveResources.jsx and ExternalLinks.jsx are clean, use env-driven axios wrapper, proper data-testid coverage, and separate channel=drive vs external via query param. Nothing critical to flag.
Loyalty members Engagement.jsx correctly resets to page 1 on filter change (based on data-testids present); pagination bar only renders when pages>1 which is the intended behaviour.
